=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided images as visual guidance for Riven
and the burning village.

Begin from the provided final frame of Riven inside the burning village.

Maintain natural visual continuity.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Burning village at dusk.

Dense smoke, orange firelight, drifting ash and embers.

Grounded realistic movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Keep the action simple and easy to understand.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== SCENE ===

Riven stands alone inside the burning village.

She looks ahead into the dense smoke.

A faint sound comes from somewhere ahead.

Riven quietly calls:

"Father?"


No answer.


Cut behind Riven.

Through the smoke ahead,
a vague human silhouette becomes visible.

The figure is an unidentified attacker.

Keep the figure heavily obscured by smoke.

Do not clearly reveal the face,
clothing,
armor,
weapon,
or identity.


Riven watches the figure.

She realizes it is not her father.

Her hand tightens around her intact sword.


The unidentified figure suddenly rushes directly toward Riven.


Riven is caught off guard.


Before Riven can properly raise her sword to defend herself,

IMPACT.


A powerful unseen strike hits Riven
and throws her backward onto the ground.


Do not show the attack clearly.

Do not reveal the attacker's weapon.


Riven's sword does NOT break.


The intact sword is knocked completely out of Riven's hand.

It falls onto the dirt
and slides away from her.


Riven hits the ground hard.


She is conscious but stunned.


End with Riven lying on the ground
and her intact sword lying on the dirt beyond her reach.


The unidentified attacker remains somewhere inside the smoke.


CUT.
